sources.snippet: PSPNet Deep learning model for pixel‑level semantic segmentation using pyramid pooling. PSPNet (Pyramid Scene Parsing Network) is a semantic segmentation model that captures global context information by applying pyramid pooling modules. It is designed to improve scene understanding by aggregating contextual features at multiple scales.
